subject: Geopolitics
title: Mekong River Power Plays
description: One-minute skill: Mekong River Power Plays.

hook.text: China built 11 dams on the upper Mekong. Downstream, 60 million people watched their fish disappear.

buildup.text: The Mekong feeds Southeast Asia's rice bowls and fisheries. China's dams control the flow like a giant faucet.

discovery.text: Upstream dam control gives China leverage over Vietnam, Laos, Cambodia, and Thailand without firing a shot.

twist.text: Satellite data showed China held back water during a 2020 drought while downstream nations suffered. Trust eroded.

climax.text: No binding treaty governs Mekong use. China prefers bilateral deals where its size ensures it always wins.

punchline.text: Control the river and you control the region.

quiz.question: How does China use its Mekong dams as geopolitical leverage?
options: By selling hydroelectric power at premium prices
By controlling water flow that downstream nations depend on
By blocking shipping routes on the river
